metadata.title: Intravesical Gemcitabine and Docetaxel
metadata.indication: Intravesical treatment of high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer after BCG failure or where BCG is unsuitable.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Six weekly induction instillations followed by monthly maintenance for up to 18 months

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00894 Version 1. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Intravesical treatment of high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer after BCG failure or where BCG is unsuitable.

treatment.schedule_summary: Weekly sequential intravesical gemcitabine/docetaxel for 6 weeks, then monthly maintenance up to 18 months.
treatment.duration_text: Six weekly induction instillations followed by monthly maintenance for up to 18 months
